text.description_html:
Pull Trim with Rim Lock Cylinder for Panic Device

This is a Night Latch Function Pull Trim with Rim Lock Cylinder (turn key to retract latch, release/remove key to engage latch) for Global Door Controls ED-501ALARM Alarm Push Bar Exit Device, ED-501-AL Push Bar Exit Device, ED-VR531 Vertical Rod Exit Device, ED-VR531ALARM Alarm Vertical Rod Exit Device and other manufactures Panic Devices.

Also available: Pull Plate Only (no lock hole)

Packaged with rim lock cylinder, pull trim, mounting hardware and 2 keys.

Specifications for Global ED-PP05501-RC-AL Pull Trim with Rim Cylinder

  • Function: Night Latch (ANSI F03) - Turn key to retract door latch on exit device, release/remove key to re-engage.
  • Plate Material: Steel
  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Pull Plate Height: 7-7/8"
  • Pull Plate Width: 3"
  • Pull Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Mounting Holes: 3/8" Diameter, 4-5/16" Center to Center, 5/16" Offset from Plate Center Line
  • Includes Mounting Hardware
  • Includes Trim Ring
  • Includes Rim Cylinder, 5-pin Schlage "C" Keyway
